notes.text: 자연재해 시신은 전염병을 일으키지 않는다(사망 원인이 외상·익사·화재)

source: PAHO, Frequently asked questions on the management of cadavers, https://www.paho.org/en/health-emergencies/frequently-asked-questions-management-cadavers (열람: collect → store(refrigerated containers, dry ice, temporary burial) → identification(photographs, descriptive information) → traditional burial; mass burial not justified) ; 용어 페이지 절차 절
